description: Hosting the Green Climate Fund Regional Dialogue for East and South Asia, in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-07-27 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Green Climate Fund (GCF) is a fund established under the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change to provide financial support needed to developing countries to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and adapt to the adverse impacts of climate change. The said Fund conducts regional dialogues to implement projects and programmes on climate change, share challenges and lessons learned, build partnerships, and raise awareness of the Fund’s new strategies and approaches. The Asia Pacific team of the Green Climate Fund has requested to host the Green Climate Fund Regional Dialogue for East and South Asia, in Sri Lanka. About 120 representatives from 11 countries are expected to participate in the regional dialogue. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Environment to host the said Regional Dialogue from 14th to 17th September 2026 in Colombo and to sign the Agreement for the purpose between the Government of Sri Lanka and the Green Climate Fund, was approved by the Cabinet.
